scripts._comment_compile_desc: Compiles Sass to CSS with compression. Load paths allow @use 'modern-normalize' imports.
scripts._comment_watch_desc: Watches Sass files for changes and recompiles. Verbose mode shows detailed output.
scripts._comment_watch_11ty: Runs Eleventy dev server with live reload. Watches HTML templates and content.
scripts._comment_optimize_desc: Converts images to WebP, videos to WebM. Generates responsive sizes and poster frames.
scripts._comment_prebuild: Runs automatically before 'build'. Ensures CSS is compiled first.
scripts.build: npx @11ty/eleventy && npm run optimize:images && npm run optimize:videos
scripts._comment_build_desc: Full production build: 1) Generate HTML, 2) Optimize images, 3) Optimize videos. Output: dist/
scripts._comment_serve_desc: Fast dev mode. Compiles CSS once, then runs watch:scss and watch:11ty in parallel. No optimization.
scripts.serve:full: npm run optimize:images && npm run optimize:videos && npm-run-all compile:scss --parallel watch:*
scripts._comment_serve_full: Full dev mode with optimized assets. Slower start, but tests production asset pipeline.
scripts._comment_serve_verbose: Dev mode with verbose logging for debugging Sass and Eleventy.
